glossary_feedback.observation: The self-referral page names the Community Resource Platform as the Referral Source system, which the Referral source entry supports (it operates the community resource referral platform). The CP entry gives that same platform name as its aka and makes the CP an intermediary's system. The glossary does not say whether a community resource referral platform is a CP or a referral source system, so the rule to relabel it CP would misclassify the self-referral platform.

The self-referral page says the referral target has no FHIR server in the direct referral light case, and the Direct referral entry requires both parties to have FHIR server APIs. The light variant therefore falls outside the glossary definition (D-12).

The guide describes the referral source and target as system actors in many places (for example, the platform POSTs a Task and the CBO's server is queried), while the glossary names a system actor only for the intermediary (D-11). One glossary note would cover this pattern across the guide.
